utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I’ll add those homes to the list and share the time and place with everyone.

utterances.text: Eli: I’d start with the highest-priority fix first, then move down the list. If you want, I can lay out the next step for the repair drive in order.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Mara — happy to help. Just give me a shout when it’s time, and I’ll be there with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together—do you know what they’re fixing first on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you checking. If you hear anything from Rosa, let me know what they’re starting with.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I’ll swing by the community center on Maple and keep Sunday open. Just point me to the first fix when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — start at the community center on Maple Sunday, and I’ll point you to the first fix when you arrive.

utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just the final details from Rosa — location, timing, and what folks should bring. Once I have that, I can pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll wait on Rosa’s details, then we can spread the word. Thanks, Uli.

utterances.text: Mina: Great — what supplies still need covering, and should I bring anything specific for Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — bring whatever you can, and I’ll keep spreading the repair drive details so we cover the remaining supplies. I’ll point you to the latest list for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — send me the latest list, and I’ll bring whatever’s still needed for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass along anything new about the repair drive as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — appreciate it.

utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Pia — I’m still coordinating around the school schedule. What time works best for you for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes — I can send the location and best route. Just to confirm, you’re good to take it from there?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
